subject: LLM inference telemetry activation — Datadog + Grafana pilot
messages:
From: Aisha Mistry <aisha.mistry@datadog.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tomas Berger <tomas@observops.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: LLM inference telemetry — kickoff and ask

Hi Marissa,

Great meeting last week — Datadog is excited to run a short pilot to validate event-streams and metric semantics for your LLM inference platform. Specifically we'd like to: 

- Validate key LLM-specific metrics (batch_size, kv_cache_hits, per_token_latency, queue_depth).
- Confirm tagging conventions across regions and model variants.
- Exercise trace spans for request-routing/fallbacks so our dashboards can show graceful degradation.

Can your team share a metrics mapping (name -> description -> units) and a short list of endpoints we can ingest from? Attached is a template we've used previously.

Proposed timeline: 2-week tech validation starting June 7, then a joint report. Are you available for a short kickoff next week?

Thanks — happy to coordinate with Tomas from ObservOps on the instrumentation side.

Best,
Aisha
Principal Integrations, Datadog
[Attachment: dd-metrics-template.csv (csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot: LLM inference telemetry — kickoff and ask

Ben/Laura — FYI, Datadog wants to run a pilot focused on LLM-specific telemetry. Quick notes:

- They need a metrics mapping and a short list of ingestion endpoints (we already emit Prometheus + OTLP).
- Timeline target: June 7 start (2 weeks).
- ObservOps wants to help with the instrumentation adapter and dashboards.

Action items I think we should cover before replying:
1) Produce a mapping CSV that includes our internal metric id, public name, type (gauge/counter/histogram), units, and recommended tags. I started a draft based on production traces.
2) Decide if we expose a read-only OTLP endpoint in the sandbox (easier) or push metrics to a managed DD ingestion key (security/ingest cost tradeoff).
3) Prepare an SLA/redlines note for how we represent degraded fallback tiers in dashboards.

Ben — can you and infra confirm whether a sandbox OTLP exporter keyed to the pilot org is feasible? Laura — can you review the mapping draft and add any missing LLM-specific metrics (kv cache hit ratio, batch padding overhead, streaming chunk latency)?

I'll reply to Aisha with a proposed kickoff window once we confirm.

—Marissa
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rls-telemetry-metrics-mapping.csv (working draft)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot: LLM inference telemetry — kickoff and ask

Marissa/Laura — infra can stand up a temporary OTLP ingestion endpoint in our sandbox cluster for the pilot. Notes: 

- We can grant Datadog a scoped ingestion key that only writes to the pilot project for 2 weeks. No access to production metrics.
- Token rotation and network policy will be enforced; minimum retention for pilot logs will be 14 days.
- We need to agree on what counts as PII/PIA in traces; traces will be sampled and we will strip prompt text (we already do this by policy).

I'll prepare a small runbook for onboarding the token and the network allowlist. Blocking question: do we want ObservOps in the ingest path or only as a consultant? The former adds complexity but speeds delivery.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Mistry <aisha.mistry@datadog.com>, Tomas Berger <tomas@observops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: LLM inference telemetry — kickoff and ask

Hi Aisha / Tomas — thanks, we can run the pilot. Summary and ask from Redwood: 

What we'll provide (by Jun 4):
- rls-telemetry-metrics-mapping.csv: mapping of ~18 LLM-specific metrics (attached).
- Sandbox OTLP endpoint + scoped Datadog ingestion key (Ben will create).
- Runbook for token onboarding and allowed network CIDRs.

What we need from Datadog (by Jun 4):
- Verification of metric naming conventions and tag set (so we can align our exporters).
- Dashboard wireframes for batch and streaming paths (per_token_latency P50/P95, kv_cache_hit_ratio, batch_efficiency).
- Any additional trace sampling requirements.

Operational: proposed kickoff meeting June 8 at 10:00am PT for 30 minutes. Please confirm. Also, Tomas — please confirm whether ObservOps will act as a passthrough ingest (full involvement) or advisory only. If full involvement, include scope and cost estimate.

Attachments: rls-telemetry-metrics-mapping.csv (draft).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this validated.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rls-telemetry-metrics-mapping.csv (csv)]

From: Aisha Mistry <aisha.mistry@datadog.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tomas Berger <tomas@observops.com>, Grafana Partner Team <partners@grafana.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: LLM inference telemetry — kickoff and ask

Thanks everyone — confirmed items and next steps:

- June 8, 10:00am PT kickoff accepted. Calendar invite incoming.
- Datadog will review the mapping and send naming suggestions by June 4.
- Grafana Partner Team will draft a cross-product dashboard pattern for LLM inference (we'll share within 48 hours).
- ObservOps will act in advisory mode only for the pilot (no ingest proxy) — Tomas to share a short scope note and hourly estimate.
- Please upload the final mapping CSV and the redlines SLA draft to the Drive link Marissa shared; we'll reference HUBSPOT-12478 for pilot tracking.

One operational ask: we noticed the mapping includes a "stream_chunk_latency_ms" histogram but no bucket definition. Can you add suggested bucket boundaries so histograms render consistently in Datadog and Grafana?

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Cheers,
Aisha
Principal Integrations, Datadog
[Attachment: redlines-sla-draft.pdf (pdf)]
